string.text: Sorry, I don't have time for this right now.
Suit yourself. The offer stands, you know where to find me.
No problem. The job isn't going anywhere.
I understand. But time is against us.
Give me a moment. I'll come back for the details.
Fine, but don't keep me waiting. Time is money.
Take your time. I'll be here.
Don't take too long.
I need to think about it.
The Noise: someone has the next step of the story for you. Talk to them.
The Noise: the Kamerton for Clear Sky. Give it to Cold.
The Noise: the Kamerton for sale. Give it to Sidorovich.
The Noise: destroy the Kamerton. Talk to Wolf.
Message from Cold: "Our techs took the Kamerton apart. The Noise stopped... almost. Last night we heard it again, quieter, from the north. The Kamerton wasn't the only one."
Message from Sidorovich: "The buyers are happy, deal's done. But listen... last night the radio caught that noise again. Maybe someone built another one..."
Message from Wolf: "The Kamerton vanished into an anomaly, I saw it with my own eyes. But last night I heard the noise again. Quieter, far off, from the north. The Zone doesn't forget, kid."
Metal Cylinder
A heavy metal cylinder with worn-off military markings. It was in the package carried by Sidorovich's courier. Hold it to your ear and you can hear a faint, pulsing noise.
Viktor's PDA
The PDA of a Clear Sky scout. Recordings of the noise and a photo of a military helicopter over the swamp. Spore is waiting for it.
Kostya's PDA
The PDA of the Clear Sky strike team leader. The last entry mentions cargo from Agroprom called the Kamerton.
Flight Recorder
A scorched flight recorder from the military helicopter that went down in the Great Swamps. Encrypted with a military code.
Sidorovich's Package
A carefully wrapped and sealed package. Sid says it's ordinary goods. Better not to open it.
Convoy Officer's PDA
The PDA of the army officer from the convoy in Agroprom. The last entry breaks off mid-word.
Kamerton
A military prototype in a heavy crate. The casing is warm to the touch, and a barely audible noise comes from inside. People die because of it.
The Noise: A Job Offer
Sidorovich, the trader in the Cordon village bunker, called me on the radio. He's heard I'm new in the Zone and says he's looking for workers. I should go and see him.
Talk to Sidorovich.
You called me on the radio. Something about work?
Right, the rookie. Let me take a look at you... Thin, hungry, and with gear that wouldn't scare a blind dog. Good. The hungry ones work hard.
What kind of work?
Honest work, for now. Here's how it goes, rookie: I give you jobs, you do them, I pay. Do them well, and the jobs get better, and so does the pay. We'll start with something simple.
Something simple? Go on.
Boars. A small herd has been coming right up to the village these past few days. Hunt them down, cut off two legs with your knife and bring them to me. Boar meat sells, and I'll pay you for it.
I'm going hunting.
I've marked where they were seen. Aim for the head and don't get trampled. Once they're down, walk up to the carcass and use your knife.
The boars are dead. Here are the legs.
Fresh, good. Here's your money. But hunting is only half of it. Nobody will feed you in the Zone, and canned food runs out faster than you think. You'd better learn to cook.
The Noise: The Hunt
Sidorovich wants me to hunt the boars that have been coming up to the village, cut off two legs with my knife and bring them to him. The herd is marked on my PDA.
The boars are dead and I have two legs. Return to Sidorovich.
Cook? You want me to make you dinner?

Not me - Wolf. He keeps order in the village, and he's been sitting by the fire since morning without a bite. Here's a cooker, some charcoal and a cut of boar meat. Cook it at the campfire and take it to him. Wolf is a good man to know around here, and it won't hurt you to be on his good side.
I'll cook the meat and take it to Wolf.
Here's everything you need. Use the cooker at the campfire and pick the boar meat. Keep the cooker, you'll need it. And come back to me afterwards - I'll have a real job for you.
Wolf, Sid sent you some food. Cooked it myself.
Fresh boar, look at that. Thanks, kid. So the old miser already has you on his payroll?
Something like that. He says he'll have a real job for me.

Then go and see him, and keep your eyes open. One of his couriers was supposed to come through here yesterday and never showed up. If Sid starts talking about bandits, take it seriously. Here, a little something for the meal.
The Noise: By the Campfire
Sidorovich gave me a cooker, charcoal and boar meat. I need to cook it at the campfire and take it to Wolf.
The meat is cooked. Take it to Wolf.
Wolf is fed and happy. You mentioned a real job?

I did. Grisha, my courier from the Swamps, was due here yesterday with a package. He never arrived. This morning a bandit was seen near the village carrying a bag that isn't his. Find him, take him out and search the body. Whatever he took from Grisha is mine - bring it back. And take this double-barrel, call it an advance. You won't do this job with your bare hands.
I'll find him.
He's marked on your PDA. And don't get yourself shot - dead men don't collect payment.
The bandit's dead. He had this on him - a metal cylinder.
That's all? So the rest of the package is gone... Let me see. Military make, never seen anything like it.
There's something else. When I picked it up, my PDA started hissing. A strange, pulsing noise, and then it just stopped.

...A noise. I've been catching something like that on my radio for weeks, always right before an emission. I don't like this, rookie. Hold on to the cylinder for now, too many eyes around my counter. And here - a jacket and a gas mask. You've earned them, and you'll need them for what comes next.
The Noise: The Missing Courier
Sidorovich's courier Grisha never arrived. A bandit seen near the village may have robbed him. I need to kill the bandit and search the body. The target is marked on my PDA.
The bandit is dead and I have a metal cylinder from the courier's package. When I picked it up, my PDA caught a strange noise. Return to Sidorovich.
What comes next?

The anomaly field near the village. A Jellyfish has formed there - an artifact, worth good money. But I want more than money this time: if that noise has anything to do with anomalies, that's where you'll hear it. Bring me the Jellyfish and tell me what you heard. You'll get a proper backpack and some medicine.
I'll bring you the Jellyfish.
The spot is marked on your PDA. Take out your detector and throw bolts ahead of you. And don't keep the Jellyfish in your backpack too long, it's a bit radioactive.
I've got the Jellyfish. And Sid, the noise was there again. Louder this time, as if it were right next to me.
Twice in Cordon in one week... This is bigger than a lost package. Here's your backpack and the medicine. And listen - I think I know who might have answers.
The Noise: Jellyfish

A Jellyfish has formed in the anomaly field near the village. Sid wants it, and he wants to know whether the noise can be heard there. I need to find it with my detector. Better throw bolts ahead of me.
I have the Jellyfish. The noise was there again, louder. Return to Sidorovich.
Who might have answers?

Grisha was coming from Spore, the Clear Sky trader in the Great Swamps. Clear Sky have been listening to the Swamps for years - if anyone knows what this noise is, it's them. Take Spore the cylinder, he'll know what it is and who it was meant for. Tell him I sent you. Will you go?

Hey, you - the new face in the village. Sidorovich here, the trader in the bunker. Word travels fast: you're fresh in the Zone and short on everything. I'm always looking for people who can work. Drop by my bunker and we'll talk.
The moment you lift the cylinder, the PDA earpiece crackles: a strange, pulsing noise, like a heartbeat under static. A few seconds later, silence.
The detector went crazy. The PDA earpiece carries the same pulsing noise as by the bandit's body, only louder, as if it were right next to you. A few seconds later, silence.
I'm heading to the Swamps.
Spore is marked on your PDA. In the Swamps, stick to dry ground and stay out of the reeds after dark. And don't trust anyone who asks about the cylinder.
Sidorovich sent me. I've got something his courier was carrying.
Grisha... so he didn't make it. Show me.
A metal cylinder. The bandits had it.

Hmm. I don't know what this is, and I don't like it. Leave it with me, I'll have our techs look at it. Look, I don't know you, and in this base we don't discuss things like this with strangers. But I could use a hand. Help us out, and we'll talk as friends.
The Noise: The Road to the Swamps
Sid is sending me with the cylinder to Spore, the trader at the Clear Sky base in the Great Swamps. Grisha the courier was coming from him.
Take the cylinder to Spore at the Clear Sky base.
What do you need a hand with?

Something simple, to start. Renegades - bandits, only dumber and angrier - have crept up to the base again and they shoot anyone who goes out for water. Drive them off. I'll pay, and throw in ammo for whatever you're shooting.
I'll take care of the renegades.
They're marked on your PDA. Careful, there's a group of them. The Swamps give plenty of cover - use it.
The renegades won't bother you anymore.
I heard shooting, then silence. Good silence. Here's your money and ammo. As for the cylinder: our techs say it's part of some military device. But right now there's something more urgent.
The Noise: Renegades at the Base
A group of renegades is prowling near the Clear Sky base. Spore wants me to get rid of them. Their position is marked on my PDA.
The renegades are dead. Return to Spore.
Something urgent? What happened?
Viktor, our scout, is missing. He went to find out where the noise in the Swamps comes from and never came back. He had a PDA with recordings. Find him. And if... if he's dead, bring me that PDA.
I'll find him.
I've marked the spot his last signal came from. Search the area.
I found Viktor. He's dead. I have his PDA.

Poor kid... Show me. There's a recording of the noise. And a photo: a military helicopter flying low over the swamp, no markings. So it's the army... Here's your pay. And be careful - after every burst of the Noise the mutants go wild. Something is already prowling around the base.
The Noise: The Missing Scout
Viktor, a Clear Sky scout, went looking for the source of the noise and never came back. I need to find him and bring his PDA to Spore. The location of his last signal is marked on my PDA.
I have Viktor's PDA. Return to Spore.
What's prowling around the base?

A bloodsucker. They used to keep their distance, but ever since the Noise started, this one has been hunting our people right by the fence. I won't lie to you, it's no boar. If you don't have a decent gun and a few medkits, don't go. But kill it and I'll pay you better than for anything so far.
I'll hunt it down.
I've marked where it was last seen. When you hear heavy breathing and see the air shimmer, shoot. Don't wait for it to show itself. And aim for the head.
The bloodsucker is dead.
Really? Ha! The boys will drink to your health for a week. Here, you've earned every coupon. But don't celebrate just yet - we've got trouble with Kostya's squad.
The Noise: Bloodsucker in the Reeds
A bloodsucker, driven from its lair by the Noise, is hunting near the Clear Sky base. Spore wants me to kill it. The place where it was seen is marked on my PDA.
The bloodsucker is dead. Return to Spore.
What happened to Kostya's squad?

Kostya and three men went to check the place where Viktor photographed the helicopter. They were supposed to report in at the meeting point last night. Nothing, the radio is dead. Go to the meeting point and see for yourself. If something happened to them - Kostya always carried his commander's PDA. Take it.
I'll go to the meeting point.
The meeting point is marked on your PDA. Go carefully, something isn't right here.

Kostya's PDA, last entry: "We found where the helicopter went down. The army is looking for cargo from Agroprom, they call it the Kamerton. Patrol on our trail..." The entry breaks off. The soldiers' positions are marked in the PDA.
Kostya's squad is dead. The army killed them.
I knew it... I could feel it. What did you find?
Kostya's PDA has an entry about cargo from Agroprom. The army calls it the Kamerton. The soldiers who killed them won't hurt anyone again. Here's the PDA.

The Kamerton... This is a matter for Cold now, not for a trader. Here's your pay, everything I can spare right now. Kostya and the boys... we'll make sure they get buried. And Cold needs to hear all of this from you.
The Noise: The Strike Team
Kostya's Clear Sky squad never reported in. I need to go to the meeting point marked on my PDA and find out what happened. If they're dead, I should take the commander's PDA.

Kostya's squad is dead. According to the last entry in Kostya's PDA, they were killed by an army patrol looking for something called the Kamerton. Kostya managed to mark their position: the soldiers are still nearby. I need to eliminate them, then return to Spore with the PDA.
The army patrol is eliminated. Return to Spore with Kostya's PDA.
I'm ready to talk to Cold.

Cold leads Clear Sky. Tell him everything: the cylinder, Viktor, Kostya and the Kamerton. He'll decide what comes next. And don't let him brush you off - you know more about this than anyone in the base.
I'm going to Cold.
He's marked on your PDA. Tell him I sent you.
Spore sent me. It's about the Kamerton.
Spore told me about you. The Kamerton... Do you even know what it is?
Only that the army is looking for it and that people die because of it.

A military prototype. It's meant to trigger and measure emissions. The noise you keep hearing is the echo of its tests. If it works, emissions become a weapon. The cylinder you brought is a part of it. And now I need your help.
The Noise: Cold
Spore is sending me to Cold, the leader of Clear Sky. I need to tell him about the cylinder, Viktor, Kostya and the Kamerton.
Talk to Cold.
What do you need me to do?

The helicopter Viktor photographed went down at the edge of the Swamps. You'll know the wreck when you see it. The pilot had a flight recorder on him. If it survived, it holds the route and the orders. Find the pilot by the wreck and take the recorder. Watch out, looters are probably sniffing around already.
I'll find the recorder.
The crash site is marked on your PDA. Come back quickly.
The recorder survived, though the casing is scorched. Voices in the distance - someone is heading for the crash site. Renegades, looters.
I've got the recorder. The renegades wanted it too.

Good work. Take these tools as well, our techs can spare them - out here you will be fixing your own gear. As for the recorder, it's encrypted with a military code - we won't crack it here. Your Sidorovich, though, knows people who can crack anything.
The Noise: The Wreck
A military helicopter went down at the edge of the Swamps. The pilot's body should have a flight recorder on it. I need to get it.
I have the recorder, but renegade looters are heading for the crash site. I need to deal with them.
I have the recorder. Return to Cold.
You want me to take the recorder to Sid?
Yes. I don't like that miser, but we have no choice. Don't tell him more about the Kamerton than you have to. Sid will sell any information to the highest bidder.
I'll take the recorder to Sid.
Take care of yourself. And come back - this isn't over yet.
Sid, I'm back. I've got the flight recorder from a military helicopter. It needs decrypting.
Well, well, my investment comes back from the Swamps bearing gifts! Let me see... Military cipher. It can be done, I know a guy. But it'll cost you.
How much?
Not money. A favour. Bandits in the Garbage grabbed a package of mine. Get it back, and in the meantime my guy will work on your recorder.
The Noise: The Cipher
The recorder is encrypted with a military code. Cold is sending me with it to Sidorovich, who knows people who can crack ciphers.
Take the recorder to Sidorovich.
What package are we talking about?

Ordinary goods, nothing you need to worry about. A gang in the Garbage intercepted my man, and their boss has the package now. Deal with them and bring it back, and your recorder will sing like a bird.
I'm going to the Garbage.
They're marked on your PDA. The Garbage isn't Cordon, rookie. Over there they shoot first and never bother with questions.
I've got your package.
Not a scratch on it, excellent. Here's your pay. And your recorder is already decrypted - my guy did a fine job. You'll want to hear what's on it.
The Noise: A Favour for Sid
A gang in the Garbage has Sidorovich's package. I need to kill the bandits and get the package back from their boss. Their position is marked on my PDA.
I have Sid's package. Return to Sidorovich.
What's on the recorder?

The route of a convoy out of Agroprom. The Kamerton was being taken to a military lab, but the convoy vanished from the radar two days ago. The army pays a fortune for things like that, Clear Sky probably too, and my buyers from the Big Land would pay more than both of them together. Find the convoy, stalker. Then we'll talk about who gets it.
I'll find the convoy.
Agroprom is crawling with soldiers, mercs and worse. I've marked the convoy's last position from the recorder. Come back alive, I've got money invested in you.

Convoy officer's PDA, last entry: "The noise keeps growing, men are bleeding from their ears, we can't switch it off... Mercenaries near..." The entry breaks off. According to the signals logged in the PDA, a mercenary squad took the crate and is close by.
The Noise: The Dead Convoy
The convoy carrying the Kamerton vanished in Agroprom. Its last known position from the recorder is marked on my PDA. I need to go there and find the convoy. The officer's PDA should be on site.
The convoy soldiers lie there without a scratch, blood trickling from their ears. Mercenaries took the Kamerton. Their position is marked on my PDA. I need to eliminate them and recover the Kamerton.
I have the Kamerton.
The Noise: Kamerton

I have the Kamerton. I can give it to Cold and Clear Sky (Great Swamps), sell it to Sidorovich, or destroy it with Wolf's help (both in Cordon). All three are marked on my PDA map. The choice is mine.
Decide who gets the Kamerton.
Cold, I have the Kamerton.
By the Zone... You really have it. Give it to us, and we'll make sure nobody ever uses it. Kostya, Viktor and the others deserve that much.
Take it. Let Clear Sky deal with the Noise.
Thank you, stalker. Kostya didn't die for nothing. Take this CS-2a armor - and know that in this base you'll always be one of us.
I understand. But don't wait too long, the army is looking for it too.
Sid, I have the Kamerton.
...You actually did it. I knew you were a good investment! My buyers will pay a fortune for this. Your cut: fifteen thousand and a little something extra.
Deal. Take it.
Ha! Here's your money and an AK-74M, straight out of the crate, not a scratch on it. Clear Sky will be furious, but business is business. And don't tell anyone where the money came from.
You're thinking too long, stalker. The offer won't last forever.
Wolf, I have the Kamerton. I don't know who to give it to.
Who? Nobody, kid. Whoever gets it will want to use it. Let's throw the damn thing into an anomaly and let the Zone eat it. I'll help you.
You're right. Let's destroy it.
Good call. Nobody gets rich off it, but nobody else dies because of it either. Here, this is a Soul - I was keeping it for a rainy day. You need it more than I do.
Think it over. But don't wait for someone to come and take it from you.
Cold (Clear Sky)
Sidorovich
Wolf

Stalker, Cold here. We heard about the convoy in Agroprom. If you have the Kamerton, bring it to the Swamps. Clear Sky will study it and find out what the Noise really is. Don't give it to anyone else.

Hey, rookie, Sidorovich here. I know what you carried out of Agroprom. Bring that box to my bunker in Cordon and I'll pay you enough to stay out of the Zone for a month. Don't listen to those idealists from the Swamps.
Wolf here. I heard what you've got. That thing has killed too many already. Come see me in the Cordon village and we'll destroy it together. Nobody should have it.
The Noise - storyline complete
The Kamerton went to Clear Sky. Cold and his techs will study the Noise, and you have allies in the Swamps. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
The Kamerton went to Sidorovich, and your pockets are full of rubles. Clear Sky won't forget this betrayal. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
You and Wolf destroyed the Kamerton. Nobody profits from it, and nobody else dies because of it. The main storyline "The Noise" is complete - the rest of the Zone is yours.
